title: Goodnight Friends
yt_description:
This song helps toddlers learn a bedtime routine and how to say goodnight to friends. It's a soothing and gentle way to end the day. Your child will learn to associate bedtime with calm and happy feelings.

🎵 Goodnight Friends

Time for bed
Goodnight friends

Pip is sleepy
Lulu too

Goodnight friends
Sleep tight

Goodnight friends
Sleep tight

Goodnight all
Sleep tight

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.
